name: dimension_d2

gates.D2-G2: UST L=1024: 8/8 PLATEAU, |mean d_hat - 1.6| <= 0.15, Student-t 95% upper end < 1.85; |mean(512) - mean(1024)| <= 0.10
gates.D2-G4: count tables + manifest; same-environment byte identity; >5 MiB to a release asset

budget.overrun_action: stop at 1.5x projection or 90 min per family; record BLOCKED (budget); no reduction of S, replicates or sizes without a new version
